machine_start_gcode:
SET_PRINT_AUTO_BED_LEVELING ENABLE=1
SET_TIME_LAPSE_CAMERA ENABLE=1
;===== Snapmaker U1 start sequence =====================

BMCU_PRINT_BEGIN SCHEMA=1 RESET=1
{if is_extruder_used[0]}BMCU_PRINT_MAP TOOL=0{endif}
{if is_extruder_used[1]}BMCU_PRINT_MAP TOOL=1{endif}
{if is_extruder_used[2]}BMCU_PRINT_MAP TOOL=2{endif}
{if is_extruder_used[3]}BMCU_PRINT_MAP TOOL=3{endif}
{if is_extruder_used[4]}BMCU_PRINT_MAP TOOL=4 MATERIAL="{filament_type[4]}" COLOR="{filament_colour[4]}"{endif}
{if is_extruder_used[5]}BMCU_PRINT_MAP TOOL=5 MATERIAL="{filament_type[5]}" COLOR="{filament_colour[5]}"{endif}
{if is_extruder_used[6]}BMCU_PRINT_MAP TOOL=6 MATERIAL="{filament_type[6]}" COLOR="{filament_colour[6]}"{endif}
{if is_extruder_used[7]}BMCU_PRINT_MAP TOOL=7 MATERIAL="{filament_type[7]}" COLOR="{filament_colour[7]}"{endif}
BMCU_PRINT_COMMIT

PRINT_START


DEFECT_DETECTION_START
SET_PRINT_STATS_INFO TOTAL_LAYER={total_layer_count}
SET_PRINT_STATS_INFO CURRENT_LAYER=0
TIMELAPSE_START
M140 S{bed_temperature_initial_layer_single}
M104 T{initial_extruder} S140
M204 S10000

G28 X Y
DEFECT_DETECT_NOODLE_FIRST
;===== Bed foreign-object detection ========
T{initial_extruder}
G90
DEFECT_DETECTION_DETECT_BED
;===== Toolhead pick/place check =================
SM_PRINT_CHECK_SWITCH_EXTRUDER

;===== Auto feed, flow calibration and pre-extrusion ======================
SM_PRINT_EXTRUDER_PREHEAT EXTRUDER=1 TEMP=140
BMCU_AUTO_FEED EXTRUDER=0 INITIAL_TOOL={initial_extruder} REQUIRE_PLAN=1
SM_PRINT_FLOW_CALIBRATE EXTRUDER=0
SM_PRINT_EXTRUDER_PREHEAT EXTRUDER=2 TEMP=140
BMCU_AUTO_FEED EXTRUDER=1 INITIAL_TOOL={initial_extruder} REQUIRE_PLAN=1
SM_PRINT_FLOW_CALIBRATE EXTRUDER=1
SM_PRINT_EXTRUDER_PREHEAT EXTRUDER=3 TEMP=140
BMCU_AUTO_FEED EXTRUDER=2 INITIAL_TOOL={initial_extruder} REQUIRE_PLAN=1
SM_PRINT_FLOW_CALIBRATE EXTRUDER=2
BMCU_AUTO_FEED EXTRUDER=3 INITIAL_TOOL={initial_extruder} REQUIRE_PLAN=1
SM_PRINT_FLOW_CALIBRATE EXTRUDER=3
M104 S0 T0 A0
M104 S0 T1 A0
M104 S0 T2 A0
M104 S0 T3 A0
M104 T{initial_extruder} S{nozzle_temperature[initial_extruder] - 90}

;===== Coarse homing =================
T{initial_extruder}
M106 S255
M106 P2 S0
MOVE_TO_DISCARD_FILAMENT_POSITION
M109 T{initial_extruder} S{nozzle_temperature[initial_extruder] - 90}
ROUGHLY_CLEAN_NOZZLE_WITH_DISCARD
MOVE_TO_XY_IDLE_POSITION_EXTRUDER
G28 Z I140 J140

;===== Build plate detection =================
DETECT_BED_PLATE

;===== Deep nozzle cleaning =================
G90
G0 Z5 F10000
MOVE_TO_DISCARD_FILAMENT_POSITION
M109 S{nozzle_temperature[initial_extruder] - 50}
ROUGHLY_CLEAN_NOZZLE
MOVE_TO_XY_IDLE_POSITION_EXTRUDER
FINELY_CLEAN_NOZZLE_STAGE_1
M104 S{nozzle_temperature[initial_extruder] - 90}
G0 Z5 F10000
MOVE_TO_DISCARD_FILAMENT_POSITION
ROUGHLY_CLEAN_NOZZLE
MOVE_TO_XY_IDLE_POSITION_EXTRUDER
FINELY_CLEAN_NOZZLE_STAGE_2

;===== Precision homing =================
M106 S255
M109 S{nozzle_temperature[initial_extruder] - 90}
M190 S{bed_temperature_initial_layer_single}
M107 P2
G90
G0 Z5 F10000
WAIT_CHAMBER_TEMP TIMEOUT=180
{if curr_bed_type=="High Temp Plate"}
G28 Z Z_OFFSET -0.07
{elsif curr_bed_type=="Graphic Effect Plate"}
G28 Z Z_OFFSET -0.07
{else}
G28 Z
{endif}

;===== Snapmaker U1 plate policy =================
{if curr_bed_type=="Smooth PEI Plate"}
BED_MESH_CALIBRATE PROBE_COUNT=11,11 Z_OFFSET=-0.07
{elsif curr_bed_type=="Graphic Effect Plate"}
BED_MESH_CALIBRATE PROBE_COUNT=11,11 Z_OFFSET=-0.07
{else}
BED_MESH_CALIBRATE PROBE_COUNT=11,11
{endif}

;===== Prime line =================
G90
G1 Z1.5
G0 X85 Y1 Z2 F18000
M109 S{nozzle_temperature_initial_layer[initial_extruder]}
G1 Z0.2
M83
G1 X185 E15 F360
G1 Z1.5

G90
M106 S0
name: Snapmaker U1 BMCU
